subject.title: Compaction should use auth-profile rotation / failover within the same provider

question: Should compaction adopt same-provider auth-profile failover for auto-selected profiles, while user-selected profiles remain locked and retries apply at most one summary from a stable snapshot?
rationale: The code path is clear, but compaction retry policy changes both auth-provider routing and transcript state safety, so maintainers should approve the behavior before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Land bounded compaction failover
options.body: Review and land or replace the linked PR with same-provider-only rotation, user-lock preservation, and stable-snapshot apply-once protection.

options.title: Narrow the retry contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define stricter retry reasons, snapshot checks, or proof requirements for compaction.

options.title: Decline compaction rotation
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue only if maintainers intentionally want compaction to stay stricter than normal agent turns.

recommendation.title: Land bounded compaction failover
recommendation.body: Review and land or replace the linked PR with same-provider-only rotation, user-lock preservation, and stable-snapshot apply-once protection.
